name: match_opens_on_wickhollow
description: A match opens with the map's name, Wickhollow, not the game's; with nothing selected the info names the road's end the Holdfast. A networked window walks out while it loads, says the tide turns as the server starts the match, and announces it at Wickhollow.

steps.msg: the match opens with the map's name
with nothing selected the info shows the Holdfast

steps.assert: node('NetStatusText').text == 'Walking out · everyone\'s land checked against yours'
steps.msg: loading, the strip says the window walks out
the strip says the tide turns until turn 0
the networked match is announced at the map
